Hi Naomi — thanks for the details and attachments. I’ve reviewed the initial materials and put together a short intake summary and next steps.

Summary / intake notes:
- Counterparty: Brightline Health, Inc. (confirmed)
- Governing law: MA preferred — acceptable; we’ll flag any MA-specific clauses that deviate from Redwood’s standard (primarily indemnity and jurisdiction language).
- Data posture: limited PII; please confirm once privacy team signs off. We will treat as non-PHI for now but will include data handling safeguards.
- Order Form: invoice cadence and pilot metrics look standard; we’ll confirm billing contacts and PO when procurement provides final PO#.

Initial redline plan & target
- Target: initial internal redline + issue summary delivered by 2025-07-15 (5 business days) assuming no special evidence holds.
- If Brightline needs a counter-redline review turnaround, please flag preferred SLA for responsiveness (e.g., 3 business days).

Priority review items (I will start here):
1) Liability & cap language — propose standard Redwood cap and carveouts for gross negligence.
2) IP: confirm ownership of deliverables vs pre-existing tools.
3) Data handling & export controls: confirm controls and incorporate DPA language; request SOC2 link (provided).
4) Security evidence: SOC2 link requested (got it), but I’ll still request proof of encryption-at-rest keys if the pilot expands.
5) Order Form billing: ensure attachment maps to Exhibits and has clear SKU/pricing entries.

Open asks for Brightline to close in parallel:
- Confirm whether any PHI will be processed (affects DPA/HIPAA scope).
- Confirm PO number and final billing contact for invoice issuance.

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_redline_summary.docx (docx)

I’ll circulate the redline and a short issue log by 2025-07-15. If anything else comes up please reply on this thread and we’ll triage.
